description: This file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for sending periodic and immediate system presence updates, including connection mode, IP address, version info, and last input time, using asynchronous tasks and system info utilities.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and sending system presence information periodically and upon request.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the periodic presence update task, ensuring only one task runs at a time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing presence update task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Asynchronously collects system state and sends a presence event to an external control channel, handling errors.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Sends an immediate presence event with a specified reason, launching asynchronously.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a human-readable summary string describing the current presence state.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the app version, combining bundle short version and build number if available.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the operating system version.
